set.body:
Source: upper-layer Site/pilot design review supplied by the user on 2026-07-23.

Problem:
REQUEUED/RQ and related requeue states collapse into SlurmState.Unknown, forcing upper layers to duplicate string taxonomies. A pool needs descriptive interruption evidence without allowing the low-level library to make retry policy.

Scope and acceptance:
- Represent REQUEUED/RQ and the supported requeue variants explicitly while preserving unknown future states.
- Add a pure conservative InterruptionClass classifier below the Site boundary.
- Distinguish requeueing, infrastructure failure, scheduler policy, cancellation, workload failure, not-interrupted, and unknown.
- Do not call preemption infrastructure failure or infer voluntary cancellation from CANCELLED alone.
- Parse the same taxonomy consistently from queue and accounting state text.
- Add exhaustive table tests and wire fixtures; the classifier must not authorize retry.
set.title: P6f.22: Type requeue states and interruption evidence
